org_hunger_in_the_lake.accept_text: Ragefire Chasm opens in the south-west corner of the city. Follow the west wall south from this hold until the ground turns warm. Beyond the antechamber the chasm opens onto a lake of fire with two stone bridges across it. Taragaman sits where they cross. Do not fight him on the bridges for longer than you must.

org_sinister_edge.accept_text: Ragefire Chasm again, in the south-west corner of the city. His walkway lies beyond the Invoker's ritual hall. Take your time and your healers. A cult is a body, and Bazzalan is the knife it holds in the dark.

org_binding_invoker.accept_text: The way down is Ragefire Chasm, in the south-west corner of the city, a long walk from my door. Inside, Jergosh's chamber lies north of the lake. Mind the voidwalkers - they are his hands, and he has never once had to use his own. When he falls, break the circle. Do not read what is in it.

org_ore_deep.accept_text: Ragefire Chasm. South of my forge, in the corner where the city wall meets the rock. Troggs mine it. Elementals nest in it. Bring me lumps - black, shot with orange. You will know it when you pick it up. It will want to burn your hand.

org_pitbreaker.accept_text: Back down Ragefire Chasm, south of my forge. Inside, he is west of the warrens, past the supply racks. The diggers first - they keep him informed. Grulgash is bigger than he looks and angrier than he sounds.

org_hexed_ash.accept_text: Ragefire Chasm, across the city in its south-west corner. Pyromancers and cultists carry the ash. Zhurra is the one who makes it mean something. She holds the altar in the antechamber, behind the cages. Do not touch the ash with bare skin.

org_cinderfang.accept_text: The lake is in Ragefire Chasm, and the way in is the south-west corner of the city. It lairs on the north-east shore. The lesser ones lead you to it - they are always near a bigger one. Keep to the stone, do not touch the lava, and do not run.
